Revenue and net sales growth are consistently described (S1-S2). The explanation of growth drivers (S4-S5) aligns with the reported financial improvements (S6-S7, S9). The discussion of financial items causing net loss widening (S11-S13) is clear and consistent with the operating performance improvements. Cash flow movements (S16-S17) and equity changes (S18) are logically connected to the described financial activities. There are no material repetitions, and the summary forms a coherent narrative from operational improvements through to financial results and future outlook (S20-S21). The arithmetic differences between segment figures and consolidated totals are not presented as exhaustive additive components, so they do not constitute contradictions under the specified evaluation rules.
